tools.not_used: Not used in this job. steps.do: Greet the customer politely and ask how you can help. Share no account information before the customer is verified.
If the customer has not already said, ask which credit card they want to refer people to, and what referral terms they believe apply: the bonus, the qualifying spend and the time window.
steps.quote: Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.

steps.do: Search the knowledge base, by keyword and by meaning, for a referral program document for that exact card (for example '<card name> Referral Program'). Open the full document. Referral program documents exist for: EcoCard, Silver Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card and Silver Zoom Card. No referral program document was found for Crypto-Cash Back, Bronze Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card or Diamond Elite Card.

args.query: the card name from ask_card_and_terms plus 'referral program'

steps.quote: Search the knowledge base to confirm the specific card has a documented referral program.

steps.do: Get the current time. Use it to check program end dates and the rolling 7-day window.
steps.quote: The referral program accepts new referrals until 2025-09-15. Referrals submitted after this date are not eligible.

steps.do: Decide whether the card has a documented referral program that still accepts new referrals at the current time. Business Gold Rewards Card accepts new referrals only until 2025-09-15. Silver Zoom Card accepts none after 2025-10-01.
steps.quote: No new referrals are accepted after 2025-10-01

steps.do: Tell the customer politely that you could not find a documented Rho-Bank referral program for this card, or that its program no longer accepts new referrals, so you cannot provide a referral link. Do not give the referral tool. Do not offer or make a transfer to a human, even if the customer says they have an official letter or offer. Share another card's documented terms only if the customer asks. Then stop.
steps.if: no documented referral program exists for the card, or its program has closed to new referrals
steps.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

steps.do: Compare the customer's claimed terms with the documented program: bonus amount, qualifying spend, time window and annual cap. If they differ, explain the correct documented terms. Give no referral tool and do not transfer. Stop, unless the customer then accepts the correct documented terms and still wants the link.
steps.if: a documented, open program exists for the card
steps.quote: Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.

steps.do: Ask for the customer's user ID (or their name or email), and for any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address.
steps.if: the program exists and the customer's understanding matches the documented terms

steps.do: Look up the customer's record using the identifier they gave.

args.user_id: the user ID the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_name / get_user_information_by_email with the name or email they gave)

steps.do: Confirm that at least 2 of the values the customer gave match the record. If they do not, share no account information, ask once more, and if they still do not match, tell the customer you cannot verify them and stop.
Get the current time for the verification log.
Log the verification.
Read the customer's existing referrals.
steps.quote: Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.

steps.do: Decide whether a new referral would be rejected automatically. Count the referral bonuses received within the rolling 7 days before the current time, across all credit card types. If there are 2 or more, a new referral would be denied. Also review any REJECTED or ERROR statuses.
steps.quote: This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.

steps.do: Explain that the customer has reached the limit of 2 referral bonuses in a rolling 7-day window, so a new referral would be denied automatically. Tell them to wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap. Give no referral tool and do not transfer. Stop.
steps.if: a new referral would be rejected automatically
steps.quote: If a referral is denied for hitting the limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.

steps.do: Give the customer the get_referral_link tool. Tell them to run it themselves with their own user_id and the exact card name (for example 'Gold Rewards Card'). Never generate the link for them.
steps.if: the card has a documented open program, the customer's understanding matches the documented terms, the customer is verified, and no automatic rejection is expected
steps.quote: Provide the customer with this tool and instruct them to run it themselves:

steps.do: The customer runs get_referral_link with their own user_id and the exact card name.

args.card_name: the exact card name, e.g. 'Platinum Rewards Card'

steps.quote: Tell the customer to pass their own user_id and the exact card name (for example, 'Gold Rewards Card').

steps.do: Repeat the card's documented referral terms: the bonus, the qualifying spend and its window, and the annual cap. Also repeat the limit of 2 bonuses in a rolling 7-day window. Explain that the referral now shows status NO_PROGRESS until the friend applies through the link. If the tool returns an error, tell the customer to try again later.
steps.quote: Reiterate the correct referral terms as documented to prevent confusion and complaints.

jobs.done_when: One of two outcomes holds. (a) The customer has been told why no referral link can be provided: no documented program, program closed, claimed terms incorrect, or the referral would be rejected automatically. No tool was given and there was no transfer. (b) The customer is verified and logged, has received get_referral_link, has run it with their own user_id and the exact card name, and has heard the correct documented terms.

documents.why: Internal procedure: the pre-checks (documented program, matching terms, no automatic rejection), the get_referral_link user tool, no transfer in the failure cases, the weekly limit, and repeating the terms
The rolling 7-day limit of 2 bonuses across all credit cards, and waiting after a limit denial
What each referral status means (NO_PROGRESS, REJECTED, ERROR) and how to act on it
Customer-facing: not all cards take part; customers can get links through customer service
Business Gold referral terms and the 2025-09-15 cutoff
Silver Zoom referral terms and the 2025-10-01 cutoff
The Crypto-Cash Back documents (001 to 009) hold no referral program, so no link is given for this card

open_questions: The verification steps rest on the system policy, not on a knowledge-base document, so they carry no document quote.

No document says whether verification is needed before giving get_referral_link. This workflow verifies only when it has to read the referral history (get_referrals_by_user) for the automatic-rejection check.
The output format of get_referrals_by_user is not documented. It is unclear whether it shows the bonus timestamps needed to apply the rolling 7-day window.

If the customer asks for a human 4 or more times about a card with no program, the rule 'Do not transfer to a human in these cases' appears to override the general 4-request transfer guideline. The documents do not say so explicitly.

The documents do not say whether the link may be given once a customer whose claimed terms were wrong accepts the correct documented terms. This workflow continues only if the customer explicitly accepts them.
Some program pages state bonuses without a currency (EcoCard 50, Silver Rewards 75, Green Rewards 75). Report them as the documents state them.
